ivars.@desc: An old man wants you to bring differently colored flowers for the city's garden.
Professor Oak's aide wants you to catch an Abra.
Get some wooden planks from Viridian City and some Bricks from Pewter City.
The S.S. Anne waiter wants you to take restaurant orders while he went to get a replacement cake.
Meetup with a scientist in Viridian Forest to look for prehistoric amber.
A woman at the hotel wants you to show her a Water/Fire-type Pokémon
A fisherman wants you to fish up an old boot. Hook it up with the old rod in any body of water.
Get some steamed Krabby legs from the S.S. Anne's kitchen and bring them back to the hotel before they get cold
A boy in Cerulean City wants you bring a love letter to a Pokémon Breeder named Maude. She's probably somewhere in one of the routes near Cerulean City
A traveler in the Department Center wants you to show him a Pokémon native to the Sinnoh region.
You found a pedestal with a mysterious prism on it. There seems to be room for more prisms.
Show the Pokémon that Eevee evolves when exposed to a Moon or Sun stone to help the scientist with her research.
Ring Lavender Town's bell when the time is right to reveal its secret.
A lady wants you to give her an egg to make an omelette.
Professor Oak's aide wants you to encounter every Pokémon on Route 24.
Professor Oak's aide wants you to catch a Buneary using the Pokéradar.
A fisherman wants to know what is the sharp-toothed Pokémon that bit him in the Safari Zone's lake.
Get rid of all the Pokémon dirtying up the Cycling Road.
Find the lost Chansey's trainer!
Go meet the Cyclist at the bottom of Route 17 and beat her time up the Cycling Road!
Find all of the missing Growlithe in the routes around Saffron City.
Find an invisible Pokémon in the eastern part of Saffron City.
Find a Rare Bone using Rock Smash.
The scientist wants you to find some Quick Powder that can sometimes be found with wild Ditto in the mansion's basement.
Find a Diamond Necklace to save the man's marriage.
Recover a stolen vase from a burglar in the Pokémon Mansion
Someone wants you to go investigate the top of a waterfall near Crimson City
Put all the stranded Shellders back in the water on the route to Crimson City.
Defeat Jeanette and her high-level Bellsprout in a Pokémon Battle
A woman at the hotel wants you to show her a Normal/Ghost-type Pokémon
A child wants you to find a floating tree stump in Ilex Forest. What could she be talking about?
Bring back a souvenir from the Fuchsia City Safari Zone
Get rid of all the Pineco on Route 31 and Route 30
Find a SlowpokeTail in some flowers, somewhere around Violet City!
A fisherman wants you to show him a Feebas. Apparently they can be fished around the Sevii Islands when it rains.
